STRICT_PIT.definition: Information is available at or before the timestamp claimed by the dataset
examples: Real-time market data with verified publication timestamp

PIT_WITH_KNOWN_LAG.definition: Information is valid only after a deterministic or documented lag
PIT_WITH_KNOWN_LAG.conclusion_strength: Full evidential status with lag documented

REVISED_NON_PIT.definition: Historical values may have changed after the decision date

UNSAFE_FOR_HISTORICAL_CONFIRMATION.definition: Dataset cannot safely support historical confirmatory claims

DS-EXP-050.rationale: Market data available next trading day. Lag is known and consistent.

DS-EXP-100.rationale: Market data available next trading day.

DS-000003.rationale: FRED data with publication lag (1-2 months for monthly series).

BENCH-001.rationale: SPY market data available next trading day.

SEC_FUNDAMENTALS.rationale: SEC EDGAR filings with exact filing date as availability.
